description: FALKREATH GLOBAL SURPLUS: Wood and Hides. Economy runs on timber and hunting.
FALKREATH GLOBAL DEFICIT: Manufactured Goods. Rural backwater lacking civilized industry.
PINE FOREST: Lumber is everywhere and dirt cheap in the deep pine forests.
HUNTER'S BOUNTY: Hunting is the primary food source; meat and hides are abundant.
METAL SCARCITY: No significant mining here. Refined metals are rare.
ACADEMIC DROUGHT: No academic presence means books and magic are luxury imports.
LOCAL SMITHING: Lacking local metal, blacksmiths must import raw materials.
